newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market sees scant buying interest.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market sees scant buying interest.

text.p: Scant buying interest was seen locally or indirectly from Europe generally despite some recovery in Australian finer merino prices at this week's auctions.
The view seemed to be that firmness might not be maintained in months further ahead and that it is difficult to pass on price rises. Some traders are worried about prices they've already taken on.
Absences at the international wool conference in Boston kept the market subdued.
